title: Database
body:
It would be really nice if Claude could help the user on how to connect to - and read from  - a database. It seems to be doable with mcp, but when I ask it, it says that it’s not supported. 

To mitigate the issue, I saved all schemas to a file and put told Claude to use that. But after I have run /compact, Claude forgets this, even if I told it to save it to the file created on /init. It would be nice to have something like “always remember in every prompt”
author: mgryning
